subject: Springboard pilot credit swap & packaging clarification
messages:
From: Eliot Shaw <eliot@springboardlabs.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-11-10T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: swap pilot credits for extended pilot + packaging tweak

Hi Jonas / Marissa,

Thanks again for the intro call last week — Springboard Labs is excited about Redwood. We have a short ask: our cohort is mid-pilot and we’re running slightly above the free-tier allocation. Rather than buying add-on prepaid credits, would Redwood consider swapping up to 30% of our remaining free pilot credits into a short-term package that extends pilot support and a one-month promotional price cap?

Concretely: we have ~120k token credits left; we're proposing converting 36k tokens into a support + pricing bundle (priority onboarding hours, a 20% cap on overage rates for 60 days). This helps us finish the MVP without having to commit to Dedicated capacity yet.

I attached a quick CSV export of usage through last week (MVP_usage_report.csv). Can you share if this is something you can approve via a simple MOU or if it needs legal/finance coordination? We’d like to close before the cohort demo (Nov 18).

Best,
Eliot
Eliot Shaw
Head of Ops, Springboard Labs
ops@springboardlabs.com

Attachments: MVP_usage_report.csv (CSV, 14KB)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
To: Eliot Shaw <eliot@springboardlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-11-10T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: swap pilot credits for extended pilot + packaging tweak

Eliot — thanks for the clear ask and for sending the usage file. Quick notes from our side:

- We can do an equity-free, limited-duration swap but it needs to be conditional on usage patterns and an MOU that limits liability.
- Proposed structure (quick): convert up to 30% of remaining pilot credits -> deliverable: 8 hours of prioritized onboarding + 20% cap on per-token overage for 60 days.
- We'd like to tie conversion to an acceptance of a short MOU (not full contract) and a simple billing amendment. Legal will want to keep the swap limited to one cohort.

Can you confirm the cohort end date and whether Springboard needs any changes to billing contacts? If you’re good, I’ll route a proposed MOU to Ben (finance) and Marissa (partnerships) for sign-off.

Thanks — Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Growth, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwoodinference.com
Redwood Inference, Inc.
From: Eliot Shaw <eliot@springboardlabs.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-11-11T14:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: swap pilot credits for extended pilot + packaging tweak

Jonas — thanks, that's exactly the clarity we needed. Cohort demo is Nov 18; cohort end date (internal) is Nov 25. Billing contact is finance@springboardlabs.com (we're happy to loop them).

Attached is the usage export you asked for (same file, small updated values). We'd prefer the swap to be reversible if the cohort converts to Dedicated within 30 days (i.e., the credits convert to a discount credit applied to the first month of Dedicated). If reversing requires complex paperwork, flag it — we can accept a one-way swap too.

Happy to review a short MOU. If it helps accelerate, I can sign an electronic acknowledgment first and follow with our PO.

Thanks — Eliot

Attachments: MVP_usage_report.csv (updated)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-11-12T10:00:00-08:00
Subject: internal: pricing carve / approval path for Springboard request

Jonas / Ben — internal note on next steps:

- Pricing: support + 20% overage cap for 60 days is acceptable as a one-off pilot concession. Recommend limiting to 30% of remaining credits and one cohort only.
- Legal/Finance: Ben to draft the MOU; Irene to confirm no compliance flags for changing billing terms mid-pilot.
- Rev path: build conversion clause (if they convert to Dedicated within 30 days, apply a one-time credit equal to converted token value to month-one invoice).

Ben — can you turn this into proposed language and attach a doc we can send to Eliot? I’ll prepare the partner note for the account.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Eliot Shaw <eliot@springboardlabs.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-11-13T09:20:00-08:00
Subject: proposed_MOU_v3.docx: pilot credit conversion + support bundle (Springboard)

Eliot / team — attaching the short MOU (proposed_MOU_v3.docx) for your review. Key points summarized:

1) Scope: Up to 30% conversion of existing pilot credits (as of execution) into a Support + Pricing Bundle (8 hours onboarding, 20% overage cap for 60 days).
2) Reversibility: If Springboard converts to Redwood Dedicated within 30 days, Redwood will apply a one-time invoice credit equal to the token value converted (not > converted USD value).
3) Duration & Termination: The bundle applies only to the identified cohort and expires 60 days from effective date.
4) Liability & Data: Standard limited liability; no data residency changes.

Please review and call out any redlines. If this aligns, we can push to DocuSign and loop finance for a PO reference.

Attachments: proposed_MOU_v3.docx (DOCX, 42KB)

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
ben@redwoodinference.com
From: Eliot Shaw <eliot@springboardlabs.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-11-15T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: proposed_MOU_v3.docx: pilot credit conversion + support bundle (Springboard)

Jonas / Marissa — thanks, Ben. This looks good to us; a couple small asks: please include the billing contact (finance@springboardlabs.com) in the DocuSign envelope and add a short sentence clarifying the conversion credit posts to the first invoice after Dedicated onboarding closes. Otherwise we're ready to sign.

I can route a PO once DocuSign is received. Appreciate the quick turnaround — this will let our cohort finish MVP and present at the demo without interruption.
